comportamentos: Changed filters persist across requests, so pagination uses the current filter rather than the first one: partial. The candidate turns off session storage only for CourseClassesController and relies on ActiveScaffold carrying search params in the pagination links. That is unverified, and it does not fix the session store dirty-tracking bug behind the problem.
The fix applies to every ActiveScaffold controller (sorting, pagination and filters elsewhere): missing.
Saved user settings are kept for course classes: missing. With store_user_settings=false, the filter, sort and page are no longer remembered between visits.
justificativa: The candidate works around the symptom only in the course classes controller by turning off settings persistence; the root cause the official fix addresses (session data mutated in place and never saved) remains, so other screens are still affected and it is unclear the workaround fully fixes pagination.
